comment: She is a wonderful teacher.  I have learned so much from her!  She always helps you, and explains things perfectly.  This is y favorite class this year.

The class is straightforward and easy, but she isn't a great teacher. You never actually LEARN the material. Her classes are fairly boring, just copying notes from a powerpoint, so it's kinda hard to stay awake. Grades are several weekly homeworks, 3 major homeworks, 3 projects, and a test.

This class is really, really straightforward. Her homeworks are easy points if you put in time and are great preparation for the test. Great with her office hours, and always willing to help via email. Gives due credit for knowing how to do a problem, even if it was wrong. Lectures are boring sometimes but I think it's just the course material

very straightforward class. you know what you need to know prior to tests.  class is based on 3 hw grades, 3 test grades, and the exam.  everyday you print out a lecture and follow along to her powerpoint and fill it in.  semi-boring lectures but she tries for them not to be.
